answer: Each submission hangs on the timber of a task receipt, and the comet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the spiral of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, no identity may audit its own recruit.
